title: When Geometry Becomes an Engine
mathematical_role: Expose time-indexed metric evolution as a changing geometric world while keeping qualitative curvature concentration distinct from the geometry itself.
learning_objective: Read g(t) as an evolving metric and retain a memorable picture of geometry as a dynamical object without mistaking the plate for a computed flow.
literal_semantics: The displayed evolution law is d g/dt = -2 Ric(g).
The lower ribbon is ordered t₀, t₁, t₂.
nonliteral_semantics: The landscape is not a literal three-manifold or numerical flow state.
Contour spacing, height, color, light, and texture are aesthetic choices.
The highlighted region is not a computed singularity or certified canonical neighbourhood.

accessibility.alt_text: A luminous imagined geometric landscape evolves along a three-time ribbon under Ricci flow; a highlighted region marks qualitative curvature concentration and is explicitly not a computed singularity.
accessibility.long_description: One dominant landscape carries the composition. Contours suggest an evolving metric fabric, a warm circled region marks qualitative curvature concentration, and a t0-to-t2 ribbon names chosen metric, evolution, and local scale sharpening. Insets identify the scale microscope and claim boundary.
